title: Maintenance personnel authorization and escorted service need verified records
remediation: The maintenance authority and personnel security lead maintain approved personnel and organizations and verify authorization before unescorted service. For a sampled supervised job, record the qualified escort and approval, sanitization of volatile storage and removal or disconnection and custody of non-volatile media. Verify approved alternate controls and their implementation if equipment cannot be sanitized, removed or disconnected.

milestones.title: Collect the controlled authorization register, a redacted eligibility or escorted service record, and a storage preparation receipt or documented alternate safeguards
